description:
Read the multi-level deployment below a matrix (group → business units → sites): the sub-matrices level by level, and for each level what it decided (annual objectives and initiatives) that the level below took up, and what NOBODY took up. Also lists lower-level priorities that name nothing above (unanchored — legitimate local priorities or drift, to be discussed), and a coverage percentage.

Use it to answer "is our group strategy actually deployed in the sites?", to prepare a catchball session, or before assessing how an event at group level propagates down.

matrix_id.description: UUID of the top matrix of the cascade to read (default: the organization default matrix)
